diego: installed redwoodctl via our MSI (company package). `redwoodctl localserve` starts but `redwoodctl login` fails with a weird error: \"failed to open config: open C:\Users\Diego\OneDrive - Acme Corp\redwood\profiles.json: The system cannot find the path specified\" even though the file exists. browser opens, i approve, CLI says token saved, then immediately prints 'permission denied' and 'invalid_grant'. anyone seen OneDrive/space-in-path issues?

irene: OneDrive paths with spaces are classic Windows quoting footguns. What does `echo $Env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME` in PowerShell show? MSI sometimes sets XDG_CONFIG_HOME to a OneDrive redirect. Also check file ACLs (`Get-Acl 'C:\Users\Diego\OneDrive - Acme Corp\redwood\profiles.json'`).

diego: `echo $Env:XDG_CONFIG_HOME` -> `C:\Users\Diego\OneDrive - Acme Corp\.config`.
Get-Acl shows me as owner, full control. file is present.

sam: if the path contains spaces, and the CLI spawns a helper or does naive path splitting, it can try to open `C:\Users\Diego\OneDrive` instead of the full path. We had a related bug where we didn't quote paths when calling the browser helper on Windows. Which redwoodctl version? `redwoodctl --version`

diego: `redwoodctl 0.33.1`

cli-bot: Known: DX-5077 \"Windows MSI + XDG redirect (OneDrive) path quoting bug\". Workaround: set env var REDWOODCTL_CONFIG to a path without spaces, e.g. `%LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood\profiles.json`, or run login with explicit `--config` flag. Patch landed in 0.33.2.

irene: try `setx REDWOODCTL_CONFIG "%LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood\profiles.json"` then create the directory and ensure permissions: `mkdir %LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood` ; move existing profiles.json if you want to keep it. Then reopen PowerShell and retry `redwoodctl login`.

diego: did `setx` and moved the file. `redwoodctl login --config "%LOCALAPPDATA%\redwood\profiles.json"` completed successfully. localserve now serves my sample app. thanks! :tada:

marc: opened DX-5077 on the CLI repo and marked as high-priority for the installer too. Suggested fixes: 1) always quote config paths on Windows when invoking helpers, 2) warn at startup if XDG_CONFIG_HOME contains spaces and suggest REDWOODCTL_CONFIG fallback, 3) have installer avoid redirecting XDG to OneDrive by default.

sam: small DX note: onboarding doc should mention OneDrive/Dropbox/Network redirects and show the `setx` + sample `--config` command. saved diego a good chunk of time. :coffee:

diego: i'll attach the MSI install log and the original profiles.json to DX-5077. thanks team!
